headline: No strategy can be chosen as a likely winner: at today's costs every rule base loses ~0.1-0.2R per trade over 5 years. Only F16_FIB382@15m and F16_FIB500@15m have AI-timeframe direction evidence that survives multiple testing (gross +0.022/+0.026R vs a 0.23R cost). Wave 1 puts those two first, then fills 8 seats for test informativeness (frequency, distinct archetypes, side balance, no anti-edge), because among the remaining non-negative cells the evidence is at chance level and the choice is nearly arbitrary. Start with 10, grow to at most ~19, not 30.

recommended_count_and_why.count: 10 now (wave1); add up to 8-9 (wave2 'to_20' tier) only after the 1-2 week pilot has measured real per-call cost and the paired AI-minus-rule pipeline works; do not go to 30.
why: Evidence: 2 BH-positive AI-tf cells (both F16). Among core cells at 15m/30m/1h, cells with gross t>=1 in both halves are 22 positive vs 15 negative and |t|>=2 is 3 vs 4: chance level. DeepSeek leans negative (18 vs 41; 6 vs 24) (sel/cells.csv). Beyond ~12 seats every addition is a near-duplicate or a zero-evidence filler.

Power and multiple testing: one month detects only ~0.3R/trade per trader (LF8); 30 traders judged together in one trending month pass together by correlated luck (LF7). Fewer seats mean fewer false 'winners' in November.

Distinctness: of the 80 A/B definitions about 65 are distinct streams, and wave1 seats already share 9-20% of held time on the same coin+side (sim3), so 30 seats are far fewer independent experiments.

Cost: 10 traders fit $500 under every setup/policy; 20 fit only in ignore-new-signals mode with 30-min or event-only checks (and B/P1-ignore); 30 fit only ignore + P2/P3 and the reference plan costs $510-775/month depending on the token basis (verify2_cost_model C7/C9). Thinking effort is the biggest unknown (low $523 vs high $1,103).

selection_method: Primary evidence: 5y gross R (direction content before costs) per strategy x tf, week-clustered, BH over 307 cells (C5Y=lens/fiveyear/verify3/agg_cells.csv (verifier v3agg.py: 5y 2021-08..2026-09, v4n house exits, week-clustered t; IS<2024-07<=CF), BH over 307 cells n>=200 recomputed in sel/tab.py). Live sign not used.
Timeframe scope per trader, pre-specified: a tf is an entry tf only if its 5y gross is >0 in both halves and t>=1; others are context only; 4h only where 20x sizes.

Secondary veto: one-position trader simulation on that scope (TSIM=sel/sim3.py (5y one-position trader on the listed tfs, longer-tf then widest-stop ties, no switching, new signals ignored while holding; gross=v4n_gross/stop_frac; SE with week clusters; 5y cost, today's is ~1.5x)); veto if a half is below -0.005R (F7_RF_TRIPLE, N23_HA_ST, S4_BB_BBP, F15_ASIA_BRK, F12_MSS_DISP vetoed).
Exclusions: anti-edge (BH-negative), negative-leaning both halves, duplicates/children, near-silent, one-sided regime bets.
Ties (most seats): chosen for decisions/day, distinct archetype, low overlap (sel/ovl.py signal overlap, sim3 held-time overlap), roughly 50/50 long share. Stated as nearly arbitrary where it is.

design_implications: Verdict per trader = pre-registered paired AI-minus-rule R over every rule signal it saw (taken, skipped, near-entry), plus both coin-flip baselines (timing-matched side flip and same-side random time), day/week-block CIs, long share reported; >=~150 de-clustered decisions before any promotion (fiveyear F14, LF5). Never account P&L.

Entry tf scope per trader as listed (cells with evidence); other tfs are shown as context only. Mixing no-evidence tfs fills the one slot with zero-direction trades (TSIM: N07 30m-only +0.018 vs 15m+30m +0.001; DOGE 1h +0.031 vs 30m+1h -0.007), though these differences are within ~2 SE.

Setup B: assigned tfs, longer tf first on ties, then widest-stop coin first (+0.014R core, +0.019R DS, verify2_multi_tf), no switching, new signals ignored while holding (switching is the worst rule; ignoring is also what fits 20-30 traders in $500).

Exits in code in price/R at fixed 20x geometry, bar-close lock updates at 15m/30m (X7 +0.02-0.04R), BE only after MFE >= +1R, no time stop, no AI early profit-taking below the first rung; 1h: wider ladder as a pre-registered shadow (X12). Freeze exits per family to 12/31 (X3).

Sizing: 1% risk per stop (1.5% at 1h/4h), code picks the highest of 50/40/30/20x at which the stop sits inside the liquidation buffer (in practice 20-30x); confidence does not scale size until it is calibrated (Spearman>0 over 200+ shadow trades). 4h needs a per-signal stop+buffer < liquidation check (8.1% of 5y 4h signals at 20x liquidate before the 2 ATR stop).
Portfolio cap per coin+direction across traders (e.g. total open risk <= 3% per coin/side): wave1 pairs share 9-20% of held time on the same coin+side (F16 pair 0.18, N02-S2 0.20, F4_FAN-F7 0.18).
Coins: avoid LTC/BCH at large notional (real cost 16-19 bp vs 10 bp BTC/ETH); SOL/DOGE are cheapest per R.

Custom values: only the HTF-agreement veto and 1.5 ATR stop, in the shadow account, scored in money or R at the default stop, gate N>=100 / delta 0.05R / z adjusted for best-of-225 (~3.5) / both halves; monthly on a 26-week window, never 1-week weekly. Expect <=0.01R. Indicator-value search is negative in money (CV5).

Prompt: skip is the default; no reverse-direction entries; no carry-over of recent direction lessons; no weight on 'other strategies agree' or 'resistance ahead' (CF5, CF13); deprioritise 15m entries 16-21 KST at most as a tie-breaker.
Budget: pin effort/thinking per call type, cap max_tokens, set max_retries, pre-warm or stagger caches at bar close, count late answers; Opus twins only 2-3 (each needs its own cache writes).
Count families, not definitions, in BH and in reporting (F16 pair = one family).
what_would_change_my_mind: A trader's pre-registered paired AI-minus-rule gain >= +0.2R/decision at 15m (>= 0.15R at 30m, >= 0.1R at 1h) with a day-block CI above 0 over >=150 de-clustered decisions, holding in both a rising and a falling week, and beating both coin-flip baselines: then weight that strategy up.
If 5m-resolution exits or a 2020-2021 out-of-period test remove the F16 BH significance, the two F16 seats lose their special status and all 10 seats become informativeness picks.
If the live every-signal gross of F16_FIB382/500 is below about -0.05R after ~500 signals, drop the F16 rationale (not before; smaller samples are noise).
If measured per-call cost in the pilot is well below the model (~$0.01/decision or less with thin holding checks), 20 seats are affordable sooner; if thinking runs high (>$0.02), stay at 10.
A new definition (D-list or other) passing a pre-registered 5y test with BH-positive gross at an AI timeframe would earn a seat ahead of the chance-level fillers.
Evidence that AI confidence is calibrated would justify risk scaling, not more seats.
honest_warnings: No strategy is verified not to lose. The best trader-level rule bases still net -0.05R (DOGE 1h) to -0.15R per trade over 5 years, and today's quiet-market cost is ~1.5x the 5y cost. The AI must add ~0.2R/trade at 15m, ~0.16R at 30m, ~0.12R at 1h, about ten times anything measured so far.

Selection beyond the two F16 cells is nearly arbitrary: core cell evidence is at chance level, and swapping, e.g., V39_ALL for S2_ST_ROC, N12 for N07 or F9_IFVG for F9_FVG would be equally defensible.

Trader-level 5y gross of every selected seat lies between +0.007 (F4_FAN) and +0.031R (DOGE 1h) with week SE 0.007-0.014: most are within 2 SE of zero. The tf-scope rule and the veto were derived on the same 5 years (in-sample).

TSIM simplifications: exits on tf bars (5m exits cut N23 4h net from +0.024 to +0.008), hold time in tf bars, entry at the signal bar, no AI behaviour; trades/day are 5y rates, and live holds run longer in quiet markets.
4h numbers cover only the ~20% of signals that size at 20x (narrow stops); the edge for all 4h signals is ~0.
Live (v3a/v3b/v4) results were not used for grading; several wave1 cells look bad live (F16 13-18 trades), which is expected noise.
With ~10-19 traders judged at once in one or two regimes, expect 1-2 traders to look significant by luck in November; only the pre-registered paired test with family-level BH should count.
DOGE 1h and other 1h seats give ~1-1.6 rule trades/day: they will not reach a verdict by 12/31 on their own; their value is the cross-tf comparison of AI added value.
